03 — Lenis
Smooth Scroll Engine

THE
DOLLY

Converts the jerky shopping-cart scroll into a buttered Steadicam glide. You're feeling it right now.

Velocity 0.00
Scroll Y 0
Progress 0%
RAF fps 60

Lenis intercepts native scroll events, applies momentum and easing, then feeds the smoothed value to GSAP ScrollTrigger — making every scroll-driven animation feel cinematic.

05 — AOS
Animate On Scroll

THE
REVEAL

Scroll-triggered fade, slide, and zoom reveals — the quickest way to bring a static page to life.

01
Fade Up
Content rises into view as you scroll — the most used AOS pattern in modern landing pages.
02
Staggered
Each card animates with a delay offset, creating a cascading wave effect across the grid.
03
Triggered
AOS watches the viewport intersection, firing once — or repeatedly — as elements enter and exit.
